design: one shared 2000 x 30000 multinomial count matrix used for every seed run, model and configuration; counts zeroed on rows invalid in that seed run; the 0% baseline of that run uses the same restricted counts
statistic: D(m,b) = mean over the 10 mask seeds of [masked AUC - 0% AUC]; contrast C(b) = D(BN,b) - D(model,b); positive = the BN degrades less
point_estimate_check: equals the 10-seed mean paired difference from sel_rq3_summary_v2.csv; max abs diff 2.39e-16 (limit 1e-12)
reading_rule: BN degrades less if the 95% percentile interval excludes 0 and is positive; tie if it includes 0; BN degrades more if it excludes 0 and is negative
coverage: Intervals cover test-row sampling and averaging over mask seeds, NOT retraining variability (models stay fixed). Primary imputer only; the median-imputed secondary models are not included.
b1_reproduction: all 120 seed runs reproduced sel_rq3_per_seed_v2.csv (max diff 9.97e-17)
excluded_large_intermediate: selection/sel_rq3_masked_predictions.pkl (94 MB, sha12 e1873f694fcf): excluded from submission, not committed
